Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
ok, a few questions (marked with "*") about diablerie in combat (Amaranth,
Liquefy the Mortail Coil). The step numbers refer to (6.5.5).

* is step 4 (getting a Master Discipline card) fully resolved before moving
to step 5 (activating Trophies), i.e. if you play a Trophy from hand and
replace it with a Master: Discipline card, it's too late to play the Master:
Discipline. Correct?

* do you apply the following effects _after_ step 5 and _before_ the 6.5.6
Blood Hunt Referendum :

-choose Charnas' new controller (if he was on the Amaranth'ed vampire) (If
the minion is burned, his or her controlling Methuselah can put Charnas on
any minion.)

-gain votes from a Political Struggle on the victim, which would affect the
blood hunt referendum (If the vampire with this card is burned or sent into
torpor, this card is burned and the acting vampire gains X votes, where X is
the number of non-contested votes the vampire with this card has.)

-play inf. Soul Stealing (Only usable when a vampire you control burns a
vampire controlled by your prey. [nec] [ACTION MODIFIER] This vampire gains
an amount of blood equal to half of the burned vampire's capacity (round
down). Ignore excess blood. [NEC] [COMBAT] As above, but usable in combat.)

-play Ritual of the Bitter Rose (Each ready vampire you control gains an
amount of blood from the blood bank equal to the amount of blood on a
vampire being burned either by diablerie or while in combat with this
vampire.)

-take the unpreventable damage from an Amaranth'ed Nakova (Camarilla
primogen: If Nakova is burned in combat, the opposing minion takes 4 damage
(damage not preventable).)

-play Draught of the Soul (Only usable when this acting vampire burns
another vampire.)

-if Aziz (with Tajdid) diablerizes, he gets his status counter now (Place a
status counter on Aziz each time a vampire opposing him in combat is
burned. )

-play sup. Predator's Transformation (Only usable when this vampire burns a
minion controlled by your prey, either in combat or as a (D) action. Your
prey burns two pool. )

-activate Sandra White's damage (If Sandra diablerizes an older vampire, the
controller of that vampire burns 1 pool.)

-activate a Soul Gem (meaning the "backup" vampire would affect the blood
hunt referendum, if he has votes) (If this vampire is burned, draw the top
card from your crypt. ) ; note : the Soul Gem obviously activated during
step 2 since it cannot be taken by the diablerist, what matters here is
whether the newly brought vampire will affect the referendum or not

-trigger Tension in the Ranks damage due to the victim burning (Whenever a
ready minion is burned or sent to torpor, his or her controller burns 1
pool.).

-play [obt] Hell-for-Leather ([obt] Play if this anarch is ready and the
opposing minion is not. The opposing minion's controller burns 2 pool.)

* follow-up questions if the above is correct : if Sandra White / Tension in
the Ranks / Predator's transformation / Hell-for-Leather pool loss oust the
Amaranth'ed victim's controller, do you still move on to 6.5.6 ? What if
Last Stand was in play, would you still move on to 6.5.6 ? (I hate this
atomic thingy diablerie..it's just fodder for aspirin makers)

*yet another follow-up question : what would happen to the diablerist going
to torpor after taking the damage from Nakova's special ? Would you still
conduct a blood hunt referendum ?

* Taste of Vitae can only be played _after_ 6.5.6 referendum ? It couldn't
be cycled between step 5 and 6.5.6 to try to fish for a Ritual of the Bitter
Rose, for instance ? [LSJ 20080527] says ToV can be played after blood hunt,
just checking if it can only be played after that blood hunt referendum, not
before.

* When would the controller of an Amaranth'ed Illusion from the Kindred
choose whether the IotK is removed from the game or burned (Remove the
{crypt card} from the game at the end of combat.) ? After the "Taste of
Vitae" step ? or after step 5 and before 6.5.6 ?

That's it for now. I'll hoard aspirin now.

thanks

Stone
